name: ks-digital-skills
description: Open skills for AI agents from KS Digital. Add this marketplace once, then install only the skills you want.

plugins.name: asd-ste100-english
plugins.description: Write and rewrite English in ASD-STE100 (Simplified Technical English) style, adapted from the MIT-licensed danyuchn/asd-ste100-skill: short sentences, active voice, one instruction per sentence, no semicolons, one word for one meaning, and hedges kept intact. Use for tool descriptions, error messages, prompts, inter-agent instructions, procedures and status reports, or when the user asks for STE, STE100 or "80% STE". Norwegian domain terms stay Norwegian.

plugins.name: asd-ste100-norsk
plugins.description: Write Norwegian bokmål technical text with the discipline of ASD-STE100 (Simplified Technical English), adapted to Norwegian grammar: imperative and one instruction per sentence, active voice instead of s-passive, sentence length caps, no semicolons, short compounds, one word for one meaning, and hedges kept intact. Use for instructions, error messages, operational notices, procedures and Norwegian field descriptions, or when the user asks for STE in Norwegian. Pairs with norsk-sprakvask, which owns spelling, punctuation and term choice.

plugins.name: norsk-sprakvask
plugins.description: Write and proofread Norwegian bokmål to Språkrådet norms and public-sector plain-language guidance, tailored to KS Digital: catches English-influenced phrasing and punctuation, inconsistent word forms, compound-word splits and AI-text markers in UI text, docs, commit messages, Jira issues and e-mail. Use whenever generating or editing Norwegian text.

plugins.name: polish
plugins.description: Run a cleanup review, a language pass with the STE100 and Norwegian language skills, and a correctness review on the current branch, round by round, until the project's check passes and a round finds nothing that affects correctness or a stated requirement, or until the round limit (default 3). The run always ends on a correctness review. For a change to a web interface, it first writes behaviour tests when the project has component tests, and ends the report with a click-through when tests cannot show everything or a visual decision is open.

plugins.name: guided-click-through
plugins.description: Verify the behaviour of a change to a web interface with the component tests of the project, then give the user a short click-through for what tests cannot show, such as layout, styles and visible focus. The agent does not run the app or a browser. It fixes the steps that the user reports as failed.

plugins.name: github-actions-security
plugins.description: Write and review GitHub Actions workflows, reusable workflows and composite actions so that text, code and artifacts from forks, issues and comments cannot reach the token and the secrets. Covers expression injection, privileged triggers such as pull_request_target and workflow_run, least-privilege permissions, actions pinned to a commit SHA, secrets and OIDC, caches, self-hosted runners and language-model steps. Includes a review mode mapped to the OWASP Top 10 CI/CD Security Risks.
